scope: AP residual ranker over honest dense-Prithvi crossfit features

folds.selection_order: cross-predict folds 3/4 using individually out-of-fit representations; freeze strength; only then train on both honest feature folds and evaluate fold 2

architecture.floor: exact float64 current cross-fitted scene probability converted to logit
architecture.inputs: 670 features: current score plus all dense representation/mask statistics except the rejected BCE scene residual
architecture.representation_contract: every fit sample is encoded by an adapter that excluded its fold; fold 2 is encoded by the preserved folds-3+4 adapter
architecture.scaling: training-only median and normalized IQR; sentinel absolute values >=1000 treated as missing; clipped to [-8,8]
architecture.head: 670 -> 96 -> 32 -> bounded scalar logit residual, LayerNorm/GELU/dropout, zero-initialized output
architecture.objective: SmoothAP listwise surrogate plus current-difficulty-weighted positive-negative pair loss, BCE, and residual L2
architecture.identity: zero residual exactly reproduces the current ranker

training.endpoint_rule: fixed 1500 steps for every seed and fold; no held-fold early stopping

gates.pass_action: commit the selected strength before fitting folds 3+4 and evaluating reused fold 2 once

invariants: The exact current score cache, not a float16 copy, defines the residual floor and comparisons.
The rejected end-to-end BCE residual feature is excluded.
Every fold-3/4 feature was generated by an adapter that excluded that sample's fold.
Every random module initialization and sampling generator is seed-bound.
No exact-paper or fresh external input is loaded.
Failure writes no artifact; any artifact remains Git-ignored.
